technical_and_design_decisions: Each user story will be implemented as a separate feature branch, then merged into a common increment branch.
For U1, we will extend the existing Sqoop metastore configuration to allow pluggable database via JDBC properties, rather than modifying core Spring XD framework.
For U3, we will add three new REST controller methods to expose aggregated metrics, reusing existing service classes that fetch individual metrics.
For U4, we will create a new Spring Boot auto-configuration for ModuleRunner, parsing existing xd-container properties and adapting them to Boot's environment.
For U5, we will integrate GemFire/Geode authentication properties into the data source configuration, assuming native GF auth is configured through standard Spring Data GemFire properties.
For U6, we will reuse the existing gpfdist sink code by creating a batch Tasklet that writes data via gpfdist, using Spring Batch's partitioning if needed.
For U7, we will introduce a test profile and mock beans using Spring Boot's @MockBean, separating real repository integration tests from unit tests.
For U8, we will move the reactor module source files into the core module, update import paths and Maven/Gradle dependencies, and ensure existing tests pass.
assumptions: The developer is already familiar with Spring Framework, Spring XD/Spring Cloud Data Flow, Sqoop, HDFS, REST APIs, and Spring Boot.
The existing codebase is well-structured and documented, with a clear module layout.
All required dependencies (e.g., for gpfdist, reactor) are available and compatible with the current framework version (Spring 6.0+).
Unit and integration tests already exist for each feature area; effort includes updating existing tests.
Documentation changes (U2, U5) are limited to updating Markdown/AsciiDoc files in the project's docs folder.
No additional infrastructure (e.g., cloud environments) is needed for local testing.
Effort estimates are for a single full-time developer working with standard productivity.
All user stories are independent; no dependencies or blocking issues among them.

activities.activity_description: Analyze the current Sqoop metastore implementation, design a configuration option to specify custom database properties, implement the change, update unit tests, and verify with a test configuration.

activities.activity_name: U2 - Documentation for HDFS-backed module registry
activities.activity_description: Research the recommended configuration for HDFS-backed module registry (XD-2287) and write clear documentation including example properties and usage notes.

activities.activity_name: U3 - REST API for all metrics
activities.activity_description: Add three new REST endpoints (/metrics/counters/all, /metrics/gauges/all, /metrics/rich-gauges/all) that return aggregated lists of all metrics. Implement service layer method to collect all metrics, add controller, write integration tests.

Create a new Spring Boot auto-configuration class and starter module that replaces the existing xd-container based ModuleRunner. Adapt configuration properties, ensure compatibility, add unit tests and a sample Boot application to verify.

activities.activity_name: U5 - GF source with native authentication
activities.activity_description: Extend the GF (GemFire/Geode) source to support native authentication by reading security properties (e.g., gf.security-*) and configuring the connection accordingly. Update documentation with required property locations.

Implement a new Spring Batch job that reads from a JDBC source and writes to HAWQ/GPDB via gpfdist protocol. Reuse the existing gpfdist sink writer code and adapt it as a Spring Batch ItemWriter. Create job configuration, tests.

activities.activity_name: U7 - Separate mocks from real repository in tests
activities.activity_description: Refactor the test infrastructure to isolate mock-based tests from integration tests that hit real repositories. Set up separate test profiles (e.g., 'mock' and 'integration'), annotate test classes accordingly, and ensure CI runs both profiles.

activities.activity_name: U8 - Move reactor module to core
activities.activity_description: Copy the reactor-based data processor module from the external spring-xd-modules repo into the core project. Update package imports, build configuration (Maven/Gradle), resolve dependency conflicts, and run existing tests to confirm no breakage.
Integrate all changes into a single build, run full test suite, fix any integration issues, perform manual smoke testing of key scenarios, and prepare final documentation updates.
